name: Elf Inquisitor (CR 7)
body:
ELF INQUISITOR
CR 7

XP 3,200
Elf inquisitor 8
LN Medium humanoid (elf )
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 16, flat-footed 19 (+4 armor, +3 deflection, +3 Dex, +2 shield)
hp 55 (8d8+8)
Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +10; +2 vs. enchantments
Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 shock light mace +11/+6 (1d6+1 plus 1d6 electricity), mwk dagger +11/+6 (1d4/19–20)
Ranged mwk longbow +10/+5 (1d8/x3)
Special Attacks bane (8 rounds/day)
Inquisitor Spell-Like Abilities (CL 8th; concentration +11)

6/day—relentless footing (+10 ft.)
1/day—inner strength (4d6)
At will—detect alignment
8 rounds/day—discern lies

Inquisitor Spells Known (CL 8th; concentration +10)

3rd (3/day)—dispel magic, invisibility purge, terrible remorse (DC 16)
2nd (5/day)—castigate (DC 15), confess (DC 15), hold person (DC 15), zone of truth (DC 15)
1st (5/day)—bless, forbid action (DC 14), persuasive goad (DC 14), shield of faith, wrath
0 (at will)— brand (DC 13), create water, detect magic, guidance, read magic, stabilize

Inquisition Persistence

TACTICS

Before Combat If anticipating battle, the npc casts shield of faith and uses her Judgment Surge feat.

During Combat At the beginning of combat, the npc activates a purity and protection judgment as a swift action. She then casts hold person, terrible remorse, or castigate on obvious melee combatants. Thereafter, she uses her second judgment ability as another swift action to change her active judgments to destruction and justice, closing with her +1 shock light mace to attack opposing spellcasters. She also takes advantage of her solo tactics ability and teamwork feats, while using Step Up to press the fight.

Morale the npc fights to the death, knowing she will become a martyr in the eyes of her people if she dies. When reduced to 20 hit points or less, she uses her inner strength inquisition power to heal herself as a swift action or drinks her potion of cure moderate wounds.

Base Statistics Without her shield of faith, the npc’s statistics become: AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 16; CMD 20.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 10, Int 10, Wis 16, Cha 14
Base Atk +6; CMB +6; CMD 22
Feats Judgment Surge, Outflank, Precise Strike, Step Up B, Toughness, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (quarterstaff)
Skills Diplomacy +8 (+10 to gather information), Intimidate +12, Knowledge (arcana) +8, Knowledge (local) +5, Knowledge (nature) +5, Knowledge (nobility) +5, Knowledge (religion) +10, Perception +10, Ride +6, Sense Motive +12 (+14 to get a hunch about a social situation), Spellcraft +10, Survival +10 (+14 to follow or identify tracks); Racial Modifiers +2 Diplomacy to gather information, +2 Sense Motive to get a hunch about a social situation
Languages Common, Elven
SQ cunning initiative, desert runner, judgment 3/day, monster lore +3, solo tactics, stern gaze, track +4, urbanite
Gear potion of cure moderate wounds, scroll of consecrate, scroll of restoration, scroll of retribution, wand of stricken heart (10 charges), mwk leather lamellar armor, +1 light steel shield, +1 shock light mace, mwk dagger, mwk longbow w/ 20 arrows, cloak of protection +1, silver holy symbol of the Bountiful Morrow, five Opus Aeterna fragments (taken from the npc), 703 gp, 198 sp, 20 cp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Desert Runner (Ex)

the npc descends from a line of elves who thrive in the deepest deserts, forever roaming burned and parched lands. She receives a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue, exhaustion, or ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, or hot or cold environments. This racial trait replaces elven magic.

Urbanite (Ex)

the npc has lived in city for more than a century and has grown to know the ebb and flow of social situations just as well as the rules of the wild. She gains a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks made to gather information and Sense Motive checks made to get a hunch about a social situation. This racial trait replaces keen senses.
